verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a coding-agent platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only describes a cloud service reached through a GitHub App, Slack and Linear integrations, an API, an SDK and a CLI. The CLI wraps local Claude Code but sends telemetry to the cloud, which is not self-hosting the core product. No deployment, on-prem or self-hosted option is documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
